fusions.name: Caught by the Collar
fusions.desc: Casts a barb that deals 12 damage to the first enemy it meets, stuns it for 1 second and leaves it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Snagging Arc
fusions.desc: Sweeps a cone 3.5 tiles long that deals 7 damage to everything in it, with a 30% chance to leave each [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds. Costs 5% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Haul Into Line
fusions.desc: Sets a line 6 tiles long ahead of you for 6 seconds, dragging every enemy near it inward.

fusions.name: Barb Set Deep
fusions.desc: When you inflict a condition, 15% of the damage you deal heals you for 3 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
